paragraphs.source_en: On the seventh day of the third month in the twelfth year of Tenshō, Tokugawa Ieyasu learned through a secret report from Mizuno Tadashige, lord of Kariya Castle, that Oda Nobukatsu had executed three of his chief retainers.

units.source_en: On the seventh day of the third month in the twelfth year of Tenshō, Tokugawa Ieyasu learned through a secret report from Mizuno Tadashige, lord of Kariya Castle, that Oda Nobukatsu had executed three of his chief retainers.
units.source_zh: 天正十二年三月初七，通过刈谷城主水野忠重的密报，德川家康得知织田信雄已斩杀三家老。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天正十二年三月初七，通过刈谷城主水野忠重的密报，德川家康得知织田信雄已斩杀三家老。

paragraphs.source_en: Immediately after executing the three retainers, Nobukatsu entrusted Tsugawa Yoshifuyu's Matsugashima Castle to Takigawa Saburōbei, Okada Shigetaka's Hoshizaki Castle to Mizuno Tadashige, and Azai Tamiyamaru's Kariyasu Castle to Mori Kyūzaburō.

units.source_en: Immediately after executing the three retainers, Nobukatsu entrusted Tsugawa Yoshifuyu's Matsugashima Castle to Takigawa Saburōbei, Okada Shigetaka's Hoshizaki Castle to Mizuno Tadashige, and Azai Tamiyamaru's Kariyasu Castle to Mori Kyūzaburō.
units.source_zh: 信雄斩杀了三家老之后，立刻把津川义冬的松岛城交给泷川三郎兵卫把守，把冈田重孝的星崎城交给了水野忠重，把浅井田宫丸的刈安贺城交由森久三郎把守。

paragraphs.source_en: On the eighth, Hideyoshi issued the same order to Tsuda Yatarō.

paragraphs.source_en: On the tenth, Hideyoshi himself went from Osaka to Kyoto, and on the eleventh he sped to Sakamoto Castle in Ōmi. The extraordinary speed of his movements proved how long he had awaited this war.

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu offered no opinion on Nobukatsu's execution of the three retainers, but immediately convened a council of war at Hamamatsu Castle. Ieyasu was originally to proceed to Owari together with Nobukatsu, but matters had unexpectedly taken a different turn.

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu's sudden and baffling remark left everyone utterly at a loss.

units.source_en: Ieyasu's sudden and baffling remark left everyone utterly at a loss.

paragraphs.source_en: They exchanged glances and could not help smiling. As for the actual strategy, there was simply no need for further discussion.

paragraphs.source_en: “We shall take Hideyoshi at Sakamoto Castle completely by surprise!”

units.source_en: “We shall take Hideyoshi at Sakamoto Castle completely by surprise!”

paragraphs.source_en: Once everyone had assembled, Ieyasu had the pre-campaign meal brought in, quietly drank a little chilled sake, fondly stroked his children's heads, and at the castle gate vaulted onto his beloved warhorse.

paragraphs.source_en: At about the Hour of the Ram on the seventh day of the third month—less than three hours after word arrived that Nobukatsu had executed the three retainers—Ieyasu had completed every preparation for war.

units.source_zh: 三月初七未时左右，即信雄斩杀三家老的消息传来之后不到一个半时辰，家康就作好了战争的所有准备。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三月初七未时左右，即信雄斩杀三家老的消息传来之后不到一个半时辰，家康就作好了战争的所有准备。

paragraphs.source_en: To position himself for operations at Kiyosu, Ieyasu immediately moved his headquarters to Okazaki. He appeared perfectly calm, with nothing unusual in either expression or conduct; indeed, he seemed less excited than when setting out to hunt. In truth, Ieyasu was not nearly as calm as he appeared. This was to be a decisive contest against Hashiba Chikuzen-no-kami Hideyoshi, a once-in-an-age genius; the slightest error of command might bring utter ruin upon the Tokugawa clan.

paragraphs.source_zh: 为了能进入清洲作战，家康立即把大本营迁到了冈崎。他显得十分平静，无论神情还是举止，都没有任何异常，甚至还不如出去狩猎兴奋。其实，家康并不像表面那么平静。这可是与旷世鬼才羽柴筑前守秀吉的决战，一旦指挥稍有失误，就可能给德川氏带来灭顶之灾。

paragraphs.source_en: The vanguard was the Red Guard of Ii Manchiyo Naomasa, famed for its valor; among the commanders of the shogun's guard were Okudaira Nobumasa, Matsudaira Matashichirō, Sakakibara Koheita Yasumasa, Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu, Ōkubo Tadachika, Honda Yoshitaka, Matsudaira Ietada, Suganuma Sadamitsu, and others.

paragraphs.source_en: At noon on the thirteenth, Ieyasu, accompanied by senior retainers including Sakai Tadatsugu, Ishikawa Kazumasa, Matsudaira Ietada, and Honda Tadakatsu, conferred with Nobukatsu on military affairs in the great hall of Kiyosu Castle.

paragraphs.source_en: By then, the war clouds over northern Ise no longer permitted anyone to remain a bystander, for four days earlier, on the ninth of the third month, Nobukatsu's commander Kanbe Masatake had marched out of Kanbe Castle and attacked Kameyama Castle.
